title: DepKeeper - Python Dependency Manager
description: A CLI for keeping requirements.txt honest. It finds outdated packages, holds to the semver bounds already declared in the file, reports conflicts before a build hits them, and queries PyPI concurrently so a large file resolves in seconds rather than minutes.

title: Hallownest Codex - Hollow Knight Analyzer
description: A Streamlit app that reads Hollow Knight save files. It decrypts the .dat format, scores progress against the 112% completion target, plots what is still missing on an interactive map, suggests charm loadouts, and exports the result as a shareable report.
